The '''''Coronet Rapier''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. It was used by a crew of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Coronet Rapier'' was introduced in the [[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|second edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' as a starship that could be used by player characters if they did not have their own vessel.
